en.headline: Chief Executive accepts recommendation to appoint New Zealand judge to top court
en.dek: Sir Terence Arnold would become the sixth non-permanent judge from other common law jurisdictions, subject to Legislative Council endorsement.
body: Chief Justice Andrew Cheung welcomed the Chief Executive's acceptance of a recommendation to appoint Sir Terence Arnold as a non-permanent judge from another common law jurisdiction of the Court of Final Appeal.

The Judicial Officers Recommendation Commission made the recommendation. The Government will seek the endorsement of the Legislative Council before the Chief Executive makes the formal appointment under the Basic Law and the Court of Final Appeal Ordinance.

Sir Terence retired from the permanent bench of the Supreme Court of New Zealand in 2017. The appointment would increase the number of non-permanent judges from other common law jurisdictions from five to six, providing greater flexibility for the court's caseload. Currently there are also four non-permanent Hong Kong judges. The Court of Final Appeal sits with five judges when hearing appeals.

zh.headline: 行政長官接納推薦委任新西蘭法官為終審法院海外非常任法官
zh.dek: 區諾德爵士將成為第六名來自其他普通法司法管轄區的非常任法官，仍待立法會通過。
body: 終審法院首席法官張舉能歡迎行政長官接納司法人員推薦委員會的推薦，委任區諾德爵士為終審法院來自其他普通法司法管轄區的非常任法官。
政府將尋求立法會通過有關推薦，然後由行政長官根據基本法及終審法院條例作出正式委任。
區諾德爵士於2017年從新西蘭最高法院常任法官職位退休。是次委任將使來自其他普通法司法管轄區的非常任法官人數由五名增至六名，有助法院更靈活處理案件。目前另有四名香港非常任法官。終審法院審理上訴時由五名法官組成。
